item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of nuclear-backed coercion, territorial pressure, or domestic repression. I found no reliable 2024 source indicating Hasina used nuclear capability, nuclear rhetoric, or nuclear-linked deterrent claims for those purposes. The strongest available evidence is therefore affirmative restraint, plus the structural fact that Bangladesh is a non-nuclear-weapon state.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh committed to non-proliferation, peaceful nuclear use: FM","publisher":"BSS","date":"April 30, 2024","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news/top-news/186546","summary":"Bangladesh’s foreign minister reiterated commitment to non-proliferation, peaceful use of nuclear science, and high safety/security standards for nuclear plants.
